maintenance_led.reason: Mostly sells new engineered components (brake pads, connectors, pumps, valves) to manufacturers and plants; aftermarket is the smaller part.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are mainly private industrial, automotive, rail, chemical and energy companies; defense and aerospace is a smaller part.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through its own engineered products across Flow, Motion and Connect and Control segments; acquisitions are occasional.

mission_critical.reason: Engineered components such as Goulds pumps, Enidine absorbers and Cannon connectors are qualified into customers' products and processes.
